name: Chandrashekhar
headline: Frontend engineer who builds complex UIs (CAD editors, PDF engines, data grids), now building the AI systems behind them.
summary: PLACEHOLDER: I'm a frontend engineer working mainly with Angular, TypeScript and RxJS. I build interfaces that are hard to get right: a canvas-based CAD editor, PDF rendering, and data-heavy PrimeNG tables. I'm now learning Python backends (FastAPI) and AI engineering (LLMs, RAG, agents), and this site is where I build it in public.

availability.note: Open to frontend and AI-engineering roles.
